neighbours.label: A token that joins a first part to what follows: a prefix hyphen in a compound, or a Korean or Japanese joiner (과, 、)
fire: A new anti-fungal antibody was tested on rats.
She won All-Region honours in her first season.
The retino-tectal pathway and the ferro-electric crystal were studied.
The monoclonal reagent binds the cortico-spinal tract.
氏名、電話番号、メールを記入してください。
会社名、部署名、役職を書いてください。
quiet: A new antibody was tested on rats in the lab.
She won regional honours in her first season.
The optic pathway and the quartz crystal were studied.
The monoclonal antibody binds a spinal receptor.
メールを送ってください。
会社に電話をしてください。

notes: The other side of the neuron is a comma after a finished hyphenated modifier. Probed readings for hyphen pieces sit near 0.2, so the median threshold is at risk.
